Open font files used as Word-metric substitutes for Edit PDF text overlays.
Microsoft Word fonts (Calibri, Cambria, Arial, Times New Roman, and others)
cannot be bundled. These families are metric-compatible open replacements.

Arimo Regular and Bold (Apache License 2.0) — Arial
https://github.com/googlefonts/Arimo

Carlito Regular and Bold (SIL Open Font License 1.1) — Calibri
https://github.com/googlefonts/carlito

Caladea Regular and Bold (SIL Open Font License 1.1) — Cambria
https://github.com/googlefonts/caladea

Tinos Regular and Bold (Apache License 2.0) — Times New Roman
https://github.com/googlefonts/tinos

Cousine Regular and Bold (Apache License 2.0) — Courier New
https://github.com/googlefonts/cousine

Gelasio Regular and Bold (SIL Open Font License 1.1) — Georgia
https://fonts.google.com/specimen/Gelasio

Comic Neue Regular and Bold (SIL Open Font License 1.1) — Comic Sans MS
https://fonts.google.com/specimen/Comic+Neue

Apache License 2.0: https://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0
SIL Open Font License 1.1: https://scripts.sil.org/OFL
